title: BTC-Normalized Residual Mean Reversion on ETH
objective: Research BTC-normalized residual mean reversion on ETH 1h: regress ETH returns against BTC returns to extract BTC-neutral residuals, then apply z-score mean reversion on those residuals. Hypothesis: ETH deviates from its BTC beta relationship and those deviations statistically mean-revert, producing Sharpe >1.0 on OOS data. This is a fundamentally different signal class (statistical residuals) from all prior experiments (price-based RSI/SMA/BB/MACD/Supertrend). Test on existing ETH+BTC 1h deep data via WFA with Optuna optimization.
hypothesis: ETH returns can be decomposed into a BTC beta component and residuals. The residuals represent ETH's deviation from its BTC relationship, and these deviations mean-revert. By trading the residuals (long when z-score < -threshold, short when z-score > +threshold), we capture BTC-neutral returns that are independent of overall crypto market direction. Academic research shows BTC-neutral residual mean reversion achieved Sharpe ~2.3 post-2021.
strategy_rationale: This strategy is novel because: (1) It uses statistical residuals as the signal, not price-based indicators; (2) It creates BTC-neutral positions that are independent of crypto market direction; (3) It exploits the cointegration-like relationship between ETH and BTC while focusing on the deviations. This is fundamentally different from EMA (trend), RSI (momentum), BB (mean-reversion on price), MACD (momentum divergence), and Supertrend (volatility trend). The only prior result is EMA Trend Gate on ETH (Sharpe 0.528) - this aims to improve on that by using a different signal mechanism.

historical_depth_requirement.target: Maximum available: ETH ~7.5 years, BTC ~5 years (aligned to 2021-2026 overlap)
historical_depth_requirement.justification: Long history needed for 85+ WFA windows with 3mo train/1mo test. EMA Trend Gate used 85 windows on ETH - residual strategy should produce similar or more trades due to more frequent signals (mean-reversion on residuals vs trend-following with regime filter).

data_acquisition.reason: Both datasets already present locally - no download needed. ETH has 64,733 bars, BTC has 43,789 bars. Both have OHLCV columns required.

inputs: Reference: walk forward engine/src/strategies/ema_trend_gate.py for signal generation pattern
Reference: walk forward engine/config/strategy_ema_trend_gate.json for parameter structure
Reference: walk forward engine/strategies/ema_trend_gate/wfa_config.yaml for WFA config
implementation_steps: 1. Create strategy code: walk forward engine/src/strategies/btc_residual_reversion.py with generate_vectorized_signals() interface
2. Load both ETH and BTC CSVs, merge on timestamp to align bars
3. Compute 1h returns for both: ret_eth = (close_eth - prev_close_eth) / prev_close_eth, ret_btc similarly
4. Compute rolling beta: beta = Cov(ret_eth, ret_btc) / Var(ret_btc) over lookback window (e.g., 30 bars)
5. Compute residuals: residual = ret_eth - beta * ret_btc
6. Compute z-score of residuals: z = (residual - rolling_mean(residual)) / rolling_std(residual)
7. Entry: long when z < -entry_threshold, short when z > +entry_threshold
8. Exit: when z crosses exit_threshold (e.g., 0) or time-based hold_bars
9. Create parameter JSON: walk forward engine/config/strategy_btc_residual_reversion.json with optimization_ranges
11. Run WFA: cd 'walk forward engine' && .venv\Scripts\python.exe scripts/walk_forward_smoke_test.py --config strategies/btc_residual_reversion/wfa_config.yaml

evaluation_criteria.status_gate: Minimum 30 trades across OOS windows for statistical significance

fallback_if_blocked: If WFA execution fails (WSL pandas issue), fall back to pure Python wfa_minimal.py for proof-of-concept
If residual mean reversion produces <20 trades, reduce z-score threshold to 1.5 std (from 2.0) to increase signal frequency
notes: This is a genuinely novel signal class - statistical residuals vs price-based indicators
Academic research shows BTC-neutral residual reversion achieved Sharpe ~2.3 post-2021
Residuals should produce more frequent signals than EMA Trend Gate (which had 14.3 trades/window)
The strategy is BTC-neutral: profits from ETH-specific moves, not crypto market direction
WFA engine does not output IS Sharpe - WFR cannot be computed (known gap from EMA Trend Gate)
